laneMap.side: Prefer live entry after starter exit.
laneMap.first5: Use only if starter and top-order pressure agree.
laneMap.live: Best entry is after the opponent starter leaves.

inningMap.expectation: Diamondbacks does not need to win the first inning.
inningMap.watch: Avoid panic if early contact is decent.

inningMap.expectation: Starter window may be neutral or ugly.
inningMap.watch: F5 side is weaker than full-game/live.

inningMap.expectation: Bridge/late edge is the planned entry point.
inningMap.watch: Look for opponent starter exit or first reliever traffic.

inningMap.expectation: Diamondbacks needs pressure after the starter turns over.
inningMap.watch: This is a live-side shape, not a pregame comfort shape.

marketImplications.side: Do not treat Diamondbacks as a plain full-game ML. Price the starter window, bridge, and conversion risk separately.
marketImplications.first5: First-five may be cleaner than full game if the starter-window edge is on the pick and the late edge flips.
marketImplications.total: Over is allowed only if RF/totals backtest agrees with the line bucket.
marketImplications.firstInning: YRFI is the timing lane to compare against the side; modeled chance 86.5% YRFI.

rfLens.trustedUse: Use RF as a nonlinear totals/game-shape check first. Do not let it pick ML/F5 by itself yet.
rfLens.totalsRead: RF totals baseline can be used as a second check on the posted total.
rfLens.moneylineRead: RF moneyline history is not deployable; it can only flag disagreement for review.
rfLens.first5Read: RF first-five history is not deployable; use it as a timing warning, not a pick.
rfLens.firstInningRead: RF first-inning history is not deployable; keep it behind explicit early-run features.
